beats.label: Paste back what you actually sent
beats.cue: [needs-key] The strongest signal there is: your edit becomes the gold answer for that turn.
beats.script: The strongest signal there is: your edit becomes the gold answer for that turn. [[pause:1.8s]] Configured provider or platform credentials are required here, so the offline verifier checks the shape but does not execute the call. --session takes a sess_<16 hex> id; the substitution picks the newest session file, which only exists after the live run above.
beats.command: crewhaus feedback --session $(ls -t .crewhaus/sessions | head -1 | cut -d. -f1) --correction "Hey Sam — Thursday's shot on my end. Friday 9am work?"
